raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misframed the problem at the outset by restricting the analysis to balls 1–3 and instructing a simulation that effectively modeled only a single piston firing rather than the full multi-stage process across all 100 balls (including the possibility that a ball rolls away without being ejected). This led downstream agents to compute irrelevant near-1/3 probabilities and ultimately to the wrong conclusion, instead of analyzing which ball (among 1–100) maximizes the chance of being ejected over the entire game (correctly ball 3).
